contentPattern.structure: image + bold year label + short description, borderless 3-up grid

suitableFor: program milestone / timeline grids (image + year + description)
borderless multi-row item grids where each item leads with a year or date label
notSuitableFor: bordered news teaser grids with read-more links (use cards-news)
icon/stat bands with labels baked into images (use cards-specs)
